script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Solids And Automation Technologies se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — aapka account kaafi purana hai, lagbhag 12 saal se, aur pehle activity bhi achhi thi. Lekin last 30 days mein sirf 3 active days record hue hain aur BuyLead velocity 88.9% girr gayi hai — toh seedha aapse baat karna zaroori laga.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, yeh drop achanak aaya hai — 2 mahine pehle activity normal thi, phir ek dam se engagement almost zero ho gayi. Kya koi specific reason tha — team change hua, ya platform pe koi issue aaya, ya leads ki quality se disappointment thi?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important baat share karna chahta hoon — aapka reply rate abhi sirf 10% hai aur PNS answer rate 33% hai jo 60% benchmark se kaafi neeche hai. Matlab jo buyers aapko contact kar rahe hain, unme se 9 mein se 8 ko koi response nahi mil raha — yeh directly aapki catalog ranking aur future lead flow ko hurt karta hai.
script_parts.action: Abhi call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — aap apna IndiaMART account open karein, main aapko Lead Manager mein ek quick reply template set karne mein help karta hoon taaki future leads pe auto-response chala jaye aur reply rate turant improve ho.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, ek hi cheez commit karein — agle 7 din mein sirf 10 minutes daily platform pe dein aur jo template humne abhi set kiya hai use use karein. Ek hafte baad main personally follow-up karunga dekhne ke liye ki BuyLead activity wapas aa rahi hai ya nahi — deal?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Solids And Automation Technologies? This is calling from IndiaMART — your account is nearly 12 years old and was performing well earlier. But in the last 30 days, we've recorded only 3 active days and your BuyLead velocity has dropped by 88.9%, so I felt it was important to speak with you directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: The data shows this was a sudden cliff — activity was normal two months ago and then dropped almost to zero. Was there a specific trigger — a team change, a technical issue on the platform, or were you disappointed with the quality of leads coming in?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's a critical number to consider — your reply rate is currently only 10% and your PNS answer rate is 33%, well below the 60% benchmark. This means 8 out of every 9 buyers who reach out to you are getting no response, which directly impacts your catalog ranking and future lead flow.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one thing right now on this call — please open your IndiaMART account and I'll walk you through setting up a quick reply template in Lead Manager so that future leads get an auto-response and your reply rate starts improving immediately.
script_parts_en.close: Just one commitment, ji — spend 10 minutes a day on the platform for the next 7 days and use the template we just set up together. I'll personally follow up in a week to check if BuyLead activity is recovering — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
